---
title: "Phase 5 Cross-Frame Review"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)

output_dir <- here(
  "exploration",
  "intelligence_framework",
  "phase_5_cross_frame_integration",
  "outputs"
)

pca_variance <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_pca_variance.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
kpi_decisions <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_kpi_decisions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cluster_centroids <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_cluster_centroids.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cluster_representatives <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_cluster_representatives.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
overlap_summary <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_overlap_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
candidate_list <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_candidate_list.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cross_frame_scores <- read_parquet(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_scores.parquet"))
```

## PCA Diagnostics

```{r}
ggplot(
  pca_variance |> slice_head(n = 20),
  aes(x = principal_component, y = cumulative_variance, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative Variance",
    title = "Cumulative Variance Explained"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
```

```{r}
kpi_decisions |>
  count(recommendation) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Cluster Overview

```{r}
cluster_centroids |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r}
cluster_representatives |>
  group_by(cross_frame_cluster_name) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(cross_frame_cluster_name, cbsa_name, cross_frame_percentile, distance_to_center) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

## Overlap Review

```{r}
overlap_summary |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Candidate Markets

```{r}
candidate_list |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  select(divergence_candidate_rank, cbsa_name, cross_frame_cluster_name, cross_frame_percentile, character_percentile, livability_percentile, opportunity_percentile, divergence_candidate_score) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```
